title: Add production Weft seller key
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the explicitly approved `WEFT_SELLER_API_KEY` to Gen's encrypted production SOPS file; no existing secret material changes.
- Includes the key in the optional generation-secret upload list so the existing production workflow will not skip it.
- Keeps payment activation separate: no receiving-wallet configuration, merge, secret upload or production deployment was performed. Related integration: #14483.
- Verified SOPS decryption and exact key round-trip, unchanged existing values/ciphertexts, no plaintext key in the file, script syntax, Biome and whitespace checks.

gist.headline: A key joins the keyring
gist.blurb: The Weft seller credential has been tucked into Gen’s encrypted production keyring, with the delivery script taught to carry it along. Payment activation remains a separate button, because production deserves its little rituals.
gist.summary: Registered the approved WEFT_SELLER_API_KEY in Gen’s encrypted production SOPS secrets and added it to the optional generation-secret upload list, without changing existing secret values or activating payments.
gist.impact: Production secret uploads can now include the Weft seller credential when payment activation is ready, while the current payment and deployment setup remains unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A secure production keyring for the Weft payment integration: Polli carefully carries a tiny labeled key toward a locked, glowing retro terminal while a code-plant grows beside it. The scene represents encrypted secret preparation rather than payment activation, so the terminal is in a calm standby state.
